steps.name: c2_paste
steps.js: const d=document.querySelectorAll('details.paste')[1]; d.open=true; const T=String.fromCharCode(9); document.getElementById('pasteArea').value=[['품목','수량','단가','금액'],['A4 복사용지','5','24,000','120,000'],['볼펜(검정)','20','500','10,000'],['스테이플러','2','8,500','17,000'],['합계','','','147,000']].map(r=>r.join(T)).join(String.fromCharCode(10)); d.scrollIntoView({block:'center'}); await sleep(400)
